snippet.title: The Dark Legacy – Official Demo Trailer (Psychological Horror Game | Steam 2025)
snippet.description:
The Dark Legacy is a first-person psychological horror game set in an abandoned surgeon’s home, where grief turned into something far worse.

🧠 Explore memories, solve narrative puzzles, and uncover a dark legacy.

🔗 Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3708190/The_Dark_Legacy_Demo/?beta=1
💬 Join the community on
🎮 Discord : https://discord.gg/wskpRwWe4
